top_signals.title: Rubio Warns Russia and China Are Already Moving in the Arctic
top_signals.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has signaled a renewed American push to strengthen security in the Arctic, warning that US adversaries and competitors are already acting in a region of growing strategic importance. Standing alongside Iceland's foreign minister, Thorgerour Katrin Gunnarsdottir, Rubio, on the first stop of a three-nation tour of NATO allies, cast the strategically located NATO member as a critical link in the defense of North America and Europe. top_signals.summary:

top_signals.title: Australia's High Court Blocks Major Coal Mine Expansion Over Emissions
top_signals.summary: Australia’s High Court, the highest authority in the country, ruled against the planned expansion of a major coal mine because of its expected effect on emissions. Climate change activists expect the ruling to affect future decisions on hydrocarbon projects in the country. Mach Energy, a local coal miner, planned to expand its Mount Pleasant mine’s output and productive life until 2048, doubling production with an additional 406 million tons of coal.
